name: sharable-bible-reading-plan
description: A personal, resumable Bible-reading plan with contextual study and private progress tracking in Google Sheets.

interface.shortDescription: Personal Bible reading with private progress tracking.
interface.longDescription: Begin or continue a flexible Bible-reading plan with concise literary, historical, cultural, and language context. Each user keeps an independent progress record in a private Google Sheet in their own Google Drive.
capabilities: Google Drive connection required for progress tracking
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Sharable Bible Reading Plan to set up or continue my personal Bible reading plan.
